list: The official 55 trophies as published by PlayStation, 2026-11-18. Names, descriptions and grades match the official list; counts are those the list tracks, as published on PSNProfiles and Exophase.

trophies.guide: The platinum. It pops automatically the moment you earn the other 54 trophies, so there is nothing to do for this one directly. Work through the roadmap in this guide — story first, then side missions, activities and collectibles — and it unlocks with the last trophy you earn. Source: official trophy description (PlayStation trophy list).
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.source: Official trophy description, PlayStation trophy list

trophies.guide: Finish the opening mission, Gone Fishing. This is the first story mission, so it unlocks naturally as you play through the opening of the game — no preparation or side work is needed, and it cannot be missed. Source: official trophy description (PlayStation trophy list).
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.source: Official trophy description, PlayStation trophy list

trophies.guide: Play through Chapter 1 to its end. Chapter trophies unlock from story progress alone, so just follow the main story missions in order; nothing here can be missed. Source: official trophy description (PlayStation trophy list).
trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.source: Official trophy description, PlayStation trophy list

trophies.guide: Play through Chapter 2 to its end. Like the other chapter trophies, this one comes from story progress alone — keep following the main missions and it unlocks. Source: official trophy description (PlayStation trophy list).
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.source: Official trophy description, PlayStation trophy list

trophies.guide: Play through Chapter 3 to its end. Story progress only; follow the main missions in order and the trophy unlocks when the chapter closes. Source: official trophy description (PlayStation trophy list).
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.source: Official trophy description, PlayStation trophy list

trophies.guide: Play through Chapter 4 to its end. This is the last chapter trophy, so once it pops you are into the endgame stretch of the story. Story progress only, nothing to prepare. Source: official trophy description (PlayStation trophy list).
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.source: Official trophy description, PlayStation trophy list

trophies.guide: Finish the final mission of the story. This is the gold story trophy and it unlocks when the credits roll on the last mission — unmissable, since the final mission is part of the main story. Before you start it, consider finishing any trophies tied to one-off story moments first (see the Missables section), then play the finale. Source: official trophy description (PlayStation trophy list).
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.source: Official trophy description, PlayStation trophy list

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Breakfast Run. Named-mission trophies like this one unlock by playing the mission when the story offers it — no special approach is needed, and it cannot be missed as long as you play the story through. Source: official trophy description (PlayStation trophy list).
trophies.name: Trust
trophies.source: Official trophy description, PlayStation trophy list

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission The Cartel Heist. A heist mission in the main story: play it when it appears in your mission list and the trophy unlocks on completion. Unmissable story progress. Source: official trophy description (PlayStation trophy list).
trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.source: Official trophy description, PlayStation trophy list

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Child's Play. Play the mission when the story offers it and the trophy unlocks on completion — unmissable story progress. Source: official trophy description (PlayStation trophy list).
trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.source: Official trophy description, PlayStation trophy list

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Headliners. Play the mission when the story offers it; the trophy unlocks on completion. Unmissable story progress. Source: official trophy description (PlayStation trophy list).
trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.source: Official trophy description, PlayStation trophy list

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission VCIA Takedown, set at Vice City International Airport. Play it when the story offers it; the trophy unlocks on completion. Unmissable story progress. Source: official trophy description (PlayStation trophy list).
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.source: Official trophy description, PlayStation trophy list

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Operation Savage Glory. Play it when the story offers it; the trophy unlocks on completion. Unmissable story progress. Source: official trophy description (PlayStation trophy list).
trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.source: Official trophy description, PlayStation trophy list

trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion in the game's in-game stats. This is the gold completion trophy and it is the long grind: it counts story progress plus the side content the game tracks toward 100% (missions, activities, collectibles and exploration). Work through every section of this guide, and check the in-game completion percentage in the stats menu as you go so you can see what is still missing. It unlocks only when the counter hits 100%. Source: official trophy description (PlayStation trophy list).
trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.source: Official trophy description, PlayStation trophy list

trophies.guide: Pull off 250 stunts — jumps, near misses, drifts, airtime and the like, as the game counts them. The count is cumulative across the whole playthrough, so just drive hard and stunt often; it builds up naturally over a full playthrough. For the last stretch, find a good jump spot and repeat the same stunt, since the counter keeps counting every successful one. Track your progress in the in-game stats. Source: official trophy description (PlayStation trophy list); count of 250 as listed on the PlayStation trophy list (PSNProfiles / Exophase).
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.source: Official trophy description and count, PlayStation trophy list (PSNProfiles / Exophase)

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types in the game once. The list of activities is not spelled out in the official description, but the count is 9 — work through the activities this guide covers (stunts, shooting range, drone races, races, fishing, arcade games, meditation, bowling and exploring the map's side content) and tick each type off as you try it. Anything you have already done for another trophy counts. Source: official trophy description (PlayStation trophy list); count of 9 activity types as listed on the PlayStation trophy list (PSNProfiles / Exophase).
trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.source: Official trophy description and count, PlayStation trophy list (PSNProfiles / Exophase)

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. Find the shooting range, work through every challenge, and repeat any you do not gold the first time until the medal turns gold — the trophy needs gold on all 42, not just a pass. Take your time, learn each challenge's target pattern, and use the best weapon the range offers for that challenge. Source: official trophy description (PlayStation trophy list); count of 42 challenges as listed on the PlayStation trophy list (PSNProfiles / Exophase).
trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.source: Official trophy description and count, PlayStation trophy list (PSNProfiles / Exophase)

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at all 14 locations. Each location has its own drone race to win — fly the course cleanly, learn the gates on a first run, then push for the win on the next attempt. You do not need to win them all in one sitting; wins are remembered per location. Source: official trophy description (PlayStation trophy list); count of 14 locations as listed on the PlayStation trophy list (PSNProfiles / Exophase).
trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.source: Official trophy description and count, PlayStation trophy list (PSNProfiles / Exophase)

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. The word different matters: the same race won twice counts once, so you need 20 distinct races on your win list. Work through the race events across Leonida — road races, off-road and any other race type the game offers — and vary the events you enter. Source: official trophy description (PlayStation trophy list); count of 20 as listed on the PlayStation trophy list (PSNProfiles / Exophase).
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.source: Official trophy description and count, PlayStation trophy list (PSNProfiles / Exophase)

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Cal is a fishing rival: take on his fishing challenge and out-fish him. The official description does not say where or when the challenge is offered, so look for Cal at fishing spots as you explore, and take the challenge when it appears. A good rod and patience with the reeling timing should carry the day. Source: official trophy description (PlayStation trophy list).
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.source: Official trophy description, PlayStation trophy list

trophies.guide: Complete one arcade game. Find an arcade machine in Leonida, start a game and play it to its end — any arcade game counts. This is one of the quickest trophies in the list: a single completed game is all it takes. Source: official trophy description (PlayStation trophy list).
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.source: Official trophy description, PlayStation trophy list

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission in Andy's mission strand. Andy is one of the side characters who gives you missions across Leonida: follow his strand through to its last mission and the trophy unlocks. Side-character strands are separate from the main story, so keep taking Andy's missions whenever they appear. Source: official trophy description (PlayStation trophy list).
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.source: Official trophy description, PlayStation trophy list

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission in Kenton's mission strand. Follow Kenton's missions through to the last one; the trophy unlocks when that final mission is done. Keep an eye out for his missions between story beats. Source: official trophy description (PlayStation trophy list).
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.source: Official trophy description, PlayStation trophy list

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission in Billy's mission strand. Follow Billy's missions through to the last one; the trophy unlocks on completion. Side strands like this one are easy to leave unfinished, so finish them before the finale if you can. Source: official trophy description (PlayStation trophy list).
trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.source: Official trophy description, PlayStation trophy list

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across Leonida. Strangers are the side characters marked around the state: each one offers a small strand of missions, and you need to finish 8 whole strands. Explore the map, take every stranger mission you find, and finish each strand rather than starting many and leaving them half done. This pairs naturally with the individual final-mission trophies for Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy and Tyrone. Source: official trophy description (PlayStation trophy list); count of 8 strands as listed on the PlayStation trophy list (PSNProfiles / Exophase).
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.source: Official trophy description and count, PlayStation trophy list (PSNProfiles / Exophase)

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission in Randy's mission strand. Follow Randy's missions through to the last one; the trophy unlocks on completion. As with the other side-character strands, take his missions whenever they appear so the strand does not get left behind. Source: official trophy description (PlayStation trophy list).
trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.source: Official trophy description, PlayStation trophy list

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission in Tyrone's mission strand. Follow Tyrone's missions through to the last one; the trophy unlocks on completion. Finish side strands as they come up rather than saving them all for the endgame. Source: official trophy description (PlayStation trophy list).
trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.source: Official trophy description, PlayStation trophy list

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 meditation spots across Leonida. Meditation spots are scattered around the state — find one, meditate there, and move on to the next. The count is cumulative, so explore the map thoroughly and check off each spot as you visit it; scenic overlooks and quiet places are good candidates. Source: official trophy description (PlayStation trophy list); count of 18 spots as listed on the PlayStation trophy list (PSNProfiles / Exophase).
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.source: Official trophy description and count, PlayStation trophy list (PSNProfiles / Exophase)

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Bret asks you to hunt a specific unique animal — the official description does not name the animal or where it lives, so take Bret's mission when it appears and follow its lead in-game. Bring a good rifle, track carefully, and take the shot cleanly. Source: official trophy description (PlayStation trophy list).
trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.source: Official trophy description, PlayStation trophy list

trophies.guide: Complete 3 collectible card sets. Collectible cards are hidden around Leonida; a set is complete when you have every card in it, and you need 3 finished sets. Pick up every card you spot as you explore — cards found during story and side missions count — and revisit areas to sweep up the ones you missed. Source: official trophy description (PlayStation trophy list); count of 3 sets as listed on the PlayStation trophy list (PSNProfiles / Exophase).
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.source: Official trophy description and count, PlayStation trophy list (PSNProfiles / Exophase)

trophies.guide: WAiNK It at 100 locations. WAiNK It is a location-based activity — visit 100 distinct locations and do it at each one. The count is cumulative and spread across the whole map, so make it a habit: whenever you arrive somewhere new, WAiNK It before you leave. Exploration trophies like exploring all of Leonida pair well with this one. Source: official trophy description (PlayStation trophy list); count of 100 locations as listed on the PlayStation trophy list (PSNProfiles / Exophase).
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.source: Official trophy description and count, PlayStation trophy list (PSNProfiles / Exophase)

trophies.guide: Complete 50 challenges. Challenges are the game's side objectives, tracked in your stats — finish any 50 of them across all types. They accumulate naturally as you play, stunt, race, explore and fight, so this one mostly takes care of itself over a full playthrough; check your challenge list late in the game and mop up the easiest remaining ones. Source: official trophy description (PlayStation trophy list); count of 50 as listed on the PlayStation trophy list (PSNProfiles / Exophase).
trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.source: Official trophy description and count, PlayStation trophy list (PSNProfiles / Exophase)

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner beside you, build up a 4-star wanted level, then lose the cops and escape. The key detail is your partner: do this while playing together, not solo. Rack up heat in a quiet area away from heavy police presence, then break line of sight, switch vehicles and lay low until the stars clear. Source: official trophy description (PlayStation trophy list).
trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.source: Official trophy description, PlayStation trophy list

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner, rob 3 shops one after another without losing your wanted level — the trick is the opposite of what you would expect: you must KEEP the wanted level running through all three robberies. Plan a route past three shops, hit them in quick succession, and do not escape the police between robberies. If the stars clear, the chain breaks and you start over. Source: official trophy description (PlayStation trophy list).
trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.source: Official trophy description, PlayStation trophy list

trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Vehicles you encounter and get into count toward discovery, so drive everything you see — cars, bikes, trucks, boats and aircraft all count toward the total. The counter is cumulative across the playthrough, so variety is the strategy: do not stick to one car. Source: official trophy description (PlayStation trophy list); count of 100 as listed on the PlayStation trophy list (PSNProfiles / Exophase).
trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.source: Official trophy description and count, PlayStation trophy list (PSNProfiles / Exophase)

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies during a single use of Combat Focus. Combat Focus is the game's slow-down aiming mode: trigger it in a busy fight with at least 5 enemies in range, and line up your shots while time is slowed. A good spot is any mission or police chase where enemies group up — wait until several are close together, then activate it and drop all five before it ends. Source: official trophy description (PlayStation trophy list); count of 5 as listed on the PlayStation trophy list (PSNProfiles / Exophase).
trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.source: Official trophy description and count, PlayStation trophy list (PSNProfiles / Exophase)

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at Vice City International Airport — in plain terms, leave VCIA by air without a scheduled flight. The official description does not say exactly how this triggers, so the honest read is: get to the airport, get into an aircraft and take off on your own terms rather than through a scheduled departure. Flagged as possibly missable: it is tied to a specific place and a specific kind of moment, so keep a save before any story sequence at the airport and try it while you are there. Source: official trophy description (PlayStation trophy list).
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.source: Official trophy description, PlayStation trophy list

trophies.guide: The Rhinos are tanks, and the description is a joke about being inside one — so this trophy is about the Rhino tank. The official description does not spell out the exact trigger, so the best guidance it supports is: get into a Rhino tank and use it (the trigger is very likely tied to driving or fighting in one). Tanks usually appear at high wanted levels or military areas, so expect this one to come from chaos at 4 or 5 stars. Source: official trophy description (PlayStation trophy list).
trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.source: Official trophy description, PlayStation trophy list

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Stealth is the whole point: plan the approach, avoid cameras and guards, get in and out without raising the alarm. If you are spotted, the attempt fails — leave, lose any heat, and try again. A quiet approach at night and a fast getaway vehicle help. Source: official trophy description (PlayStation trophy list).
trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.source: Official trophy description, PlayStation trophy list

trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape after each one. Each vault robbery needs a plan and a getaway: hit the vault, grab the take, and escape the police before the trophy counts it. You need 5 successful vault robberies with escapes, not just attempts. Space them out, keep a fast car ready, and break line of sight quickly after each job. Source: official trophy description (PlayStation trophy list); count of 5 as listed on the PlayStation trophy list (PSNProfiles / Exophase).
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.source: Official trophy description and count, PlayStation trophy list (PSNProfiles / Exophase)

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. Armored trucks patrol the roads of Leonida: intercept one, stop it, take its cargo, then escape the police response. One successful robbery and escape is all it takes — keep a getaway vehicle nearby and do not linger at the scene. Source: official trophy description (PlayStation trophy list).
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.source: Official trophy description, PlayStation trophy list

trophies.guide: Explore all 52 areas of Leonida. The map is divided into 52 named areas, and visiting each one counts toward this trophy. Explore systematically — drive the highways, visit every town, beach, swamp and city district — and the counter climbs as you go. It pairs naturally with the WAiNK It and meditation trophies, which also reward covering the map. Source: official trophy description (PlayStation trophy list); count of 52 areas as listed on the PlayStation trophy list (PSNProfiles / Exophase).
trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.source: Official trophy description and count, PlayStation trophy list (PSNProfiles / Exophase)

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an illegal operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs. There are 9 gangs in Leonida, and you need to rob one illegal operation from every one of them. Learn which operations belong to which gang as you find them, and keep a mental checklist — one gang left unrobbed is all that stands between you and the trophy. Source: official trophy description (PlayStation trophy list); count of 9 gangs as listed on the PlayStation trophy list (PSNProfiles / Exophase).
trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.source: Official trophy description and count, PlayStation trophy list (PSNProfiles / Exophase)

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Head to Ocean Beach, find a bar or cocktail spot with a view of the water, and order a cocktail. This is a small flavour trophy — no combat, no grind, just a drink with a view. Source: official trophy description (PlayStation trophy list).
trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.source: Official trophy description, PlayStation trophy list

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style — a nod to the series' classic showroom smash. The official description does not name the showroom, so the honest guidance is: find a vehicle showroom, get a car inside it, and drive straight out through the glass. Flagged as possibly missable: it sounds tied to a specific scripted moment, so keep a save before any story sequence in a showroom and try the smash while you are there. Source: official trophy description (PlayStation trophy list).
trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.source: Official trophy description, PlayStation trophy list

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow through at the Kolt & Associates bowling alley — in other words, go bowling there. Find the Kolt & Associates alley, start a game and play it through. The description's 'follow-through' suggests completing a game (or a full frame) rather than just walking in, so finish what you start. Source: official trophy description (PlayStation trophy list).
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.source: Official trophy description, PlayStation trophy list

trophies.guide: A partnership with mass appeal. The description is deliberately vague — it points at the partnership between the two protagonists reaching a wide audience. The official description does not say what triggers it, so the best guidance it supports is: keep playing the story with both protagonists and do the partnership content the game offers; it is very likely a story or social-media moment that unlocks as the partnership grows. Source: official trophy description (PlayStation trophy list).
trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.source: Official trophy description, PlayStation trophy list

trophies.guide: Make choices — PlayStation tracks a count of 500 for this one. Choices are the small decisions you make as you play: dialogue options, actions in missions, how you treat people. The counter builds up across the whole playthrough, so play naturally and make decisions instead of idling through conversations. Flagged as possibly missable: choices cannot always be undone, so if you are chasing this one, make an active choice whenever the game offers one rather than skipping past it. Source: official trophy description (PlayStation trophy list); count of 500 as listed on the PlayStation trophy list (PSNProfiles).
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.source: Official trophy description and count, PlayStation trophy list (PSNProfiles)

trophies.guide: Second time's the charm — succeed on your second attempt at something. The official description does not name the event, so the honest read is that this pops when you retry something and get it right the second time. Flagged as possibly missable: it sounds tied to a specific one-off moment where a first failure is followed by a success, so if you fail something once, try it again immediately rather than moving on. Source: official trophy description (PlayStation trophy list).
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.source: Official trophy description, PlayStation trophy list

trophies.guide: What the hell just happened? — witness something strange. This is the game's odd-event trophy: something weird happens somewhere in Leonida, and you need to be there to see it. The official description does not say what or where, so explore the map, poke around odd places, and keep an eye out for anything out of the ordinary. It will find you if you explore enough. Source: official trophy description (PlayStation trophy list).
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.source: Official trophy description, PlayStation trophy list

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl someone over with a melee drive-by — hit a pedestrian with a melee weapon while driving past. Get a melee weapon, find a target on foot, and drive by swinging. It needs a clean hit from the vehicle, so line up the pass at moderate speed rather than full throttle. Source: official trophy description (PlayStation trophy list).
trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.source: Official trophy description, PlayStation trophy list

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 by laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked Bills come from robberies and heists; your contacts can clean them for a cut. Keep laundering your take after every big job and the total climbs toward $250,000 — do not sit on marked bills, and do not spend them unlaundered where the game counts only laundered earnings. Source: official trophy description (PlayStation trophy list); amount of $250,000 as listed on the PlayStation trophy list (PSNProfiles / Exophase).
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.source: Official trophy description, PlayStation trophy list (PSNProfiles / Exophase)

trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Every shop purchase counts — clothes, weapons, food, vehicles, whatever the shops of Leonida sell. The counter is cumulative across the whole playthrough, so just buy what you need as you go and it builds up; late in the game, a big vehicle or weapon purchase can close the gap. Source: official trophy description (PlayStation trophy list); amount of $100,000 as listed on the PlayStation trophy list (PSNProfiles / Exophase).
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.source: Official trophy description, PlayStation trophy list (PSNProfiles / Exophase)

trophies.guide: Purchase all 8 garage properties. Garages are properties you can buy around Leonida, and you need all 8. They cost money, so save up — and note that garages also give you somewhere to store the vehicles you discover for the Whip It Good trophy. Buy them as you can afford them; the trophy pops when the eighth deed is yours. Source: official trophy description (PlayStation trophy list); count of 8 as listed on the PlayStation trophy list (PSNProfiles / Exophase).
trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.source: Official trophy description and count, PlayStation trophy list (PSNProfiles / Exophase)

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Find vehicles around Leonida, open the Scooter Bros app on your in-game phone, and register them — 10 registrations earn the trophy. Any vehicle counts, so register the ones you drive anyway and keep an eye out for new ones. Source: official trophy description (PlayStation trophy list); count of 10 as listed on the PlayStation trophy list (PSNProfiles / Exophase).
trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.source: Official trophy description and count, PlayStation trophy list (PSNProfiles / Exophase)
